title: Bacterial plasma membrane: role

claims.text: Which role is associated with a bacterial plasma membrane? Plasma membrane: Selectively separates the cell interior from its surroundings. This is a model; bacterial structures vary among species.
This model shows selected structures; their presence and arrangements differ among bacteria.
